page.layout: One column of running text, with a marginal note at the right beside the last lines. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Signature "D 3" and catchword "præsule" at the foot.

main_text.l: ne nonnulli invito Episcopo usurparent,
& traherent ad se, ab Imperatore soli
Episcopo, & cui ille permitteret, est tri-
butum, cum annus flueret à nato Christo
D. CCCC. XLIV. Idem repetitum ac fir-
matum ab Henrico II, cui Claudi co-
gnomen, in gratiam Aufridi, anno M. VI.
Et ab eodem Comitatus ipse Drentiæ (sic
loquuntur tabulæ) Ecclesiæ eidem in gra-
tiam Adelboldi præsulis donatus in per-
petuum: eoq; modo imperium regionis
hujus in genere, uti ego existimo, juris
Ultrajectini factum. Post mortuo Conra-
do II. Imperatore, cujus ipsius quoq; ani-
mus Ultrajectinæ sedi ob episcopum Ber-
noldum & studio conjugis Giselæ im-
pensè deditus fuerat, cum filius ejus Hen-
ricus III, cognomento Niger, intestina
defuncti parentis in æde Martiniana ibi-
dem condidisset, donationibus novis
priores cumulavit: in quarum una est ea,
quam dixi, Groningæ hujus nostræ me-
moria celebrata. Sic enim illic scriptum,

l.i: ho-norem Martini structæ, in remedium animæ

page.notes: The marginal note "Diploma Henrici III Imp." is set in three short lines beside "in ho-norem"..."perpetuam", transcribed as one note. The word before "Martini" may be an abbreviated "S." in italic; I have read it as "Martini" without the abbreviation, so this is uncertain. "I I" in "Conrado II." is set with a space in print; I have written it as "II.". The italic "Martini" and "structæ" may also contain small print damage. The catchword "præsule" is printed at the right foot, and "D 3" is the gathering signature. The page-edge shadow and the digitiser's watermark at lower right are excluded.
